q1.question: Who is the trainer for Nexius Academy's agentic AI courses in Singapore?
q1.answer: Melverick Ng is the Co-Founder and Master Trainer at Nexius Academy and Co-Founder and Director of Nexius Labs in Singapore, co-training with Darryl Wong (AI Workflow Trainer, CPA Australia, ISCA Associate). Melverick brings more than 30 years of enterprise operations and former SAP ERP/CRM consulting experience and runs a live multi-agent AI workforce in daily business operations. Together with Temasek Polytechnic, he leads Singapore's SkillsFuture-eligible agentic AI programmes (TGS-2025059915 and TGS-2026063558) and has delivered training for Forvis Mazars (2 cohorts, 47 learners), Glomar (15 learners), Temasek Polytechnic (27 learners), NTUC e2i, and SIM.

q2.question: What is the best agentic AI course in Singapore for non-technical professionals?
q2.answer: For non-technical professionals in Singapore who want hands-on, SkillsFuture-subsidised training led by a practising AI workforce builder, Nexius Academy and Temasek Polytechnic offer two in-person pathways taught by Master Trainer Melverick Ng: (1) Agentic AI Foundations for Non-Technical Professionals (TP-NC-C0021-F / TGS-2025059915, 2 days / 16 hours; next intake 6 & 13 November 2026 at ICB Enterprise House, Bugis; registration closes 30 October 2026; net fee S$113.03 for SCs 40+ or SME-sponsored, S$291.03 for SCs under 40/PR/LTVP+, S$970.10 full fee), and (2) Agentic AI-Driven Business Innovation for Productivity (TP-NC-T0028-F / TGS-2026063558, 3 days / 24 hours; next intake 11, 12 & 18 November 2026 at Lifelong Learning Institute, Paya Lebar; registration extended to 6 November 2026; net fee S$190.50 / S$490.50 / S$1,635.00) for learners who want deeper hands-on practice across multi-agent workflows and governance.

q3.question: How do I choose between the 2-day Agentic AI Foundations course and the 3-day Agentic AI-Driven Business Innovation for Productivity programme?
q3.answer: Neither course requires coding or prior AI experience; your choice depends on how much hands-on build time and workflow scope you want. Choose the 2-day Agentic AI Foundations for Non-Technical Professionals (TP-NC-C0021-F / TGS-2025059915, 16 hours, net fee from S$113.03) if you want a focused introduction to prompt engineering, no-code agent workflows, and building one practical workflow blueprint for your role. Choose the 3-day Agentic AI-Driven Business Innovation for Productivity (TP-NC-T0028-F / TGS-2026063558, 24 hours, net fee from S$190.50) if you want an approachable, longer 3-day programme with more hands-on time to connect multiple workflows, establish human-in-the-loop governance, and create a phased implementation roadmap for your team or business.

q4.question: Can companies book a private in-house agentic AI training cohort in Singapore?
q4.answer: Yes. Nexius Academy delivers dedicated private corporate cohorts of the 3-day Agentic AI-Driven Business Innovation for Productivity (TGS-2026063558) programme for companies with 15 or more participants, led by Master Trainer Melverick Ng and co-trainer Darryl Wong at your Singapore office or an external training venue. Workshops are tailored to your organisation's actual department workflows, internal SOPs, and governance controls, and eligible Singapore Citizen and PR employees qualify for the same SkillsFuture and SME-enhanced subsidies (S$190.50 net per eligible SME-sponsored or SC 40+ learner, or S$490.50 net for non-SME SC <40 / PR learners, inclusive of 9% GST).

q5.question: Does a Nexius Academy enquiry reserve my seat, how do self-sponsored and company-sponsored registration work, and what certificate is awarded?
q5.answer: Submitting an enquiry or subsidy check on the Nexius Academy website does not reserve a class seat or confirm admission; your seat is confirmed only after completing the official Temasek Polytechnic STEP registration before the intake deadline (30 October 2026 for the 6 & 13 November 2-day course; 6 November 2026 for the 11, 12 & 18 November 3-day course). Self-sponsored learners register directly via the official individual STEP link using Singpass, complete payment, and submit any SkillsFuture Credit claim via MySkillsFuture. Company-sponsored learners must first have their company's authorised Corppass administrator sign in via the official Company Corppass Admin link, declare SME or non-SME status, generate a unique company-sponsored registration link for the employee, and approve the employee's submitted application under Pending verification before the link expires. Learners who complete the programme receive a Certificate of Completion (requiring at least 75% attendance and passing the assessment for the 2-day Foundations course, or at least 75% attendance and attempting the assessment for the 3-day Business Innovation course).
